Lizzy Mendoza: Quick update — launching BridgeSwap pilot and Headcount Policy v2 today. Short note: BridgeSwap = 2-quarter rotations to share skills across infra/product/platform. Priority hiring approved for Capacity & Observability. Headcount Policy v2 adds a required ROI stub on HC requests. Doc: https://redwood-internal/people/bridgeswap-v1
Claire Wu: Congrats. Is the hiring pause still in effect? any exceptions?
Lizzy Mendoza: Hiring pause stands for non-priority reqs until June 30. Exceptions: SLA-driven capacity, security, revenue-impacting roles. Priority list in doc.
Jeffrey Chen: Does v2 add more approval steps for managers?
Lizzy Mendoza: Flow: Manager -> TL -> Finance & Capacity (if infra/GPU) -> People Ops. We added ROI and 1-paragraph customer-impact field. SLA target = 3 biz days for priority, 7 for others. Pseudocode in doc: ```manager.submit() -> auto-check(cost_center) -> finance.review() -> people.approve()```
Headcount Bot: "Headcount Policy v2 template added to /tools/hc-request. Pending drafts will be migrated on next save." :robot_face: 
Meera Singh: For Dedicated capacity, will priority reqs reserve slots or just headcount? want to avoid overprovisioning.
Rajiv Kapoor: FYI I start as Head of Capacity Monday. Short-term: favor slot-reservations over full provisioning. #capacity-priority reqs get infra-impact check before offer.
Anna Greene: Welcome Rajiv! For BridgeSwap onboarding: shadow weeks or formal handoffs?
Lizzy Mendoza: Plan: 2-week shadowing + 1-week overlap handoff at boundaries, plus a 1-page learning objective. Managers nominate 1 volunteer per team for pilot cohort.
Jeffrey Chen: Any comp/level changes for swaps?
Rajiv Kapoor: No comp changes. Participants remain on original team's comp path. Leveling exceptions go through People Ops.
Meera Singh: Can we get a consolidated list of priority reqs and business owners for planning?
Lizzy Mendoza: Yes — I will publish a read-only spreadsheet by EOD with owners and requested starts.
Claire Wu: Can BridgeSwap include a half-day infra safety checklist in onboarding?
Rajiv Kapoor: Will coordinate with Security and Infra to make one.
Anna Greene: I can run a 30-min kickoff for the pilot and help with onboarding docs.
Lizzy Mendoza: Kickoff set for next Wed 10am PST. RSVP in the doc. :calendar: 
Headcount Bot: Reminder set: kickoff scheduled by Lizzy Mendoza on 1728540000.
Lizzy Mendoza: Action items: 1) People Ops publish priority HC list (EOD) 2) Rajiv draft infra-impact checklist (Fri) 3) Managers submit BridgeSwap nominations (1/team) 4) Everyone review Headcount Policy v2 and comment.
Claire Wu: Thanks — appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup: 
Rajiv Kapoor: Excited to start. Ping me for capacity triage.
Jeffrey Chen: Noted.
Anna Greene: Will add onboarding checklist to docs repo after kickoff.
Lizzy Mendoza: Thanks all — Ill follow up after kickoff with next steps.
